node.seed.name: Seed Source
node.seed.summary: Reads JSONL / CSV / Parquet as the pipeline entry.
node.seed.help:
Entry node with no input port.
- Supports JSONL / CSV / Parquet; enable the SQLite index cache for large JSONL files.
- Disable the index cache to read JSONL as a stream.
- Output port: rows (row data).
- Preview and validate the source in the Data view before running.
node.llm.name: LLM Model Call
node.llm.summary: Calls a model per row with Fluid prompts and optional tools.
node.llm.help:
Calls OpenAI Chat / Responses or Anthropic Messages for every row.
- Prompt is a Fluid template; leave it empty to send the raw row JSON.
- Can send Tool Profile tools, row messages (multi-turn) and a JSON response schema.
- Bounded concurrency, token/cost logging and optional failure samples.
- API keys come from settings or OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
node.expression.name: Expression Transform
node.expression.summary: Reshapes each row with a Fluid template or field mapping.
node.expression.help:
Transforms every input row into a new JSON object.
- The template must render valid JSON; use {{ value | json }} to embed values safely.
- Field aliases map output names to input paths when no template is set.
- Typical use: convert raw fields into { messages: [...] } for SFT training.
node.validator.name: Validator
node.validator.summary: Validates and filters rows with expressions or JSON Schema.
node.validator.help:
Filters rows before they reach export or sampling.
- Rule kinds: expression, schema (JSON Schema), regex and script (Fluid true/false).
- Multiple rules can require all or any to pass; each row has an optional timeout.
- Pass rows leave from the pass port; rejected rows leave from reject and can also be written to a reject JSONL.
node.sampler.name: Sampler
node.sampler.help:
Samples rows or writes deterministic dataset splits.
- Configure count or ratio for simple sampling.
- Splits map to one output port and one JSONL file per split.
- An optional stratify field keeps split ratios balanced per group.
- The same seed reproduces the same result.
node.toolprofile.name: Tool Profile
node.toolprofile.help:
A configuration-only node without data ports.
- Maintain tool names, descriptions and JSON parameter schemas in the tree editor.
- Simulation / LLM nodes reference the profile by block name or profile name.
- Import and export the profile as JSON.
node.querysource.name: Query Source
node.querysource.summary: Generates simulated user queries for trajectory runs.
node.querysource.help:
Source node for agent trajectory generation.
- Enter queries with Fluid variables (for example {{ topic }} and {{ index }}).
- Or load queries from JSONL/CSV/Parquet and map the query/system fields.
- Optional system prompt is carried into the simulation.
- Output port: queries (row data).
node.simulation.name: Simulation
node.simulation.summary: Runs a mini agent harness and emits tool-call trajectories.
node.simulation.help:
Runs a multi-round model / tool loop per query.
- Scripted mode replays deterministic turns offline.
- Provider mode calls a real model; ToolMode can use simulated or real sandbox tools.
- Emits OpenAI messages ready for Cleaner and SFT Export.
- Validate with a small query set before generating at scale.
node.cleaner.name: Cleaner
node.cleaner.summary: Cleans whitespace, ANSI, reasoning and empty messages.
node.cleaner.help:
Cleans OpenAI-style message rows before export.
- Normalizes whitespace and newlines, strips ANSI escapes, removes reasoning_content and empty messages.
- Regex replacements remain editable in the config JSON.
- Non-JSON rows pass through unchanged.
node.sftexport.name: SFT Export
node.sftexport.summary: Writes messages JSONL for SFT training.
node.sftexport.help:
Sink node that writes the final SFT dataset.
- Streams rows to a temporary file and atomically replaces the target on success.
- Passes rows through and normalizes JSON without trimming fields.
- Set an output path before running; upstream is usually Simulation or LLM.
preset.llm_batch.name: LLM Batch Generation
preset.llm_batch.summary: Seed → LLM → SFT Export: read rows, generate a reply per row, export SFT JSONL.

preset.oai_clean.summary: Seed → Cleaner → SFT Export: clean existing OpenAI messages data.
preset.field_map.name: Field Mapping
preset.field_map.summary: Seed → Expression → SFT Export: map raw fields into messages JSON.
preset.validate_split.name: Validate & Split
preset.validate_split.summary: Seed → Validator → Sampler → SFT Export: drop bad rows and split by ratio.
preset.agent_trajectory.name: Simulated Agent Trajectory
preset.agent_trajectory.summary: Query Source → Simulation → Cleaner → SFT Export: offline multi-round tool trajectories.
preset.real_tools.name: Real Tool Calls
preset.real_tools.summary: Query Source → Simulation (real model + sandbox) → Cleaner → SFT Export; requires API keys.
